raw_text: Alt News investigation: The viral audio clip attributed to the state CM is AI-generated. Our analysis compared the clip against 12 hours of the CM's authenticated public speeches. Key findings: the voice lacks micro-tremors present in natural speech, pitch variation follows algorithmic patterns rather than emotional cadence, and the clip contains no environmental audio typically captured in meeting recordings.
clean_text: Alt News confirms CM audio is AI-generated. Comparison with authenticated speeches shows missing micro-tremors, algorithmic pitch patterns, and no environmental audio.
